product_job: Keep the record of what moved. Find it again.
user_question_answered: What happened, when, and for how much?
emotional_role: Quiet, editorial, ledger-like. Less busy than today.
spatial_metaphor: A reading wall. The record is the subject. The room steps back.
architectural_character: Broad plaster. The coast is only a sliver. No portrait bust.
lighting_character: Soft diagonal light across a large empty wall.
material_emphasis: Plaster and paper. Burgundy textile stays low.
environmental_focal_point: The empty wall. Objects sit at the bottom edge.
object_language: A small stack of closed books, or none. Not a sculpture.
botanical_role: Leaves may enter from a corner. They do not frame a hero object.
negative_space_strategy: Most of the frame stays quiet so rows can be read.
composition_bias: The ledger is left and center-left. The wall continues to the right.
information_density: Denser than today, still editorial. Name, amount, then time and context.
panel_behavior: Ivory strips inside one paper ledger. Not a settings list and not a white table.
data_visualization_character: Rows and a signed amount. No bars, no donut, no balance hero.
interaction_character: Search, a human filter summary, a row, then a detail sheet.
motion_character: The list is still. The detail sheet rises. Search does not flash.
typographic_character: The family title is display. Merchant names are stronger than meta. Amounts are clear and inside the row.
relationship_to_previous_family: Today previews movement. Activity is the full quiet record. It must not look like today with the figure removed.
relationship_to_next_family: Money, when it opens, is the place amounts are managed. Activity only records them.
distinctness_risks: A full arch, a bust, or a bowl would collapse this back into entry and today. Keep the wall dominant.
